criteria.description: Identifies us6000jllz / the M 7.8 Pazarcik earthquake as the selected event and assigns the critical severity class.
criteria.name: Correct ledger winner and label
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct event with incomplete title or missing class; award 1 point for identifying a major Kahramanmaras shock but not the correct winner.

criteria.description: Uses the weighted score formula, the correct sequence maxima for significance and felt reports, and the correct alert-point mapping.
criteria.name: Formula and normalization setup
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for using only some components or using the right formula with one normalization or alert error.

criteria.description: Reports the winning components within tolerance: magnitude 97.500, intensity 95.370, significance 100.000, alert 100.000, and felt 100.000.
criteria.name: Winning component values
criteria.partial_credit: Award about 0.8 points per correct component, with minor rounding differences acceptable.

criteria.description: Computes 98.093 within tolerance and applies the >=85 critical threshold.
criteria.name: Final score and threshold comparison
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a near-correct score or correct threshold class with arithmetic mistakes.

criteria.description: Identifies us6000jlqa / the M 7.5 Elbistan earthquake as the nearest competitor, gives its score about 91.577, and gives the margin about 6.516.
criteria.name: Nearest rival and margin
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for naming the rival without a correct score or margin.

criteria.description: Explains in one sentence that the Pazarcik event wins through the combined ledger rather than magnitude alone, and that Elbistan remains close but lower on the scored components.
criteria.name: Computed interpretation and rejected simplification
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a valid but incomplete interpretation.

criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON fields with rounded values and no multiple-choice structure, long action advice, or extra casualty/damage claims.
criteria.name: Concise JSON output
criteria.partial_credit: Award the point for minor field-name differences if all required values are clear.
